<Picture 1> defines the heroine’s identity, outfit, and illustration style. All views depict the same person; show only one instance of her, never the reference-sheet layout. Preserve her long pink-to-pale-blonde twin tails, black hair bows, green eyes, gold earrings, black bell choker, white short-sleeved blouse with black button placket, asymmetrical black miniskirt, and black ankle boots. Refined 2D anime animation with clean, readable silhouettes.

A six-second high-speed close-combat exchange inside a spacious industrial training hall. Yellow floor markings and evenly spaced steel columns provide clear spatial references. Her only opponent is a slightly taller, dark-gray humanoid training robot. The action feels urgent, forceful, and precise.

One continuous lateral tracking shot at full-body medium-wide framing. Keep both fighters’ hands, feet, and contact points visible. Maintain a consistent action axis. All movement plays at real-time speed: no slow motion, freeze frames, or cuts.

0.0–1.5 seconds:
The heroine stands on the left, the robot on the right, roughly two meters apart. The robot steps forward and throws a straight right punch toward her head. She immediately bends her knees, ducks beneath its forearm, and drives forward off her rear foot into close range. Show the push-off, forward travel, and planted landing as one connected motion. Her twin tails trail behind her acceleration.

1.5–3.5 seconds:
Rising from the duck, she rotates her hips and lands a sharp right straight punch against the robot’s chest armor. Her fist briefly meets resistance; the robot’s upper body recoils. She retracts the punch, shifts her weight onto her left foot, and snaps a right roundhouse kick into its left flank. The robot lowers its left forearm to block. Shin and forearm visibly collide, forcing the robot one step sideways. Her hair sweeps around after the rotation with delayed follow-through.

3.5–6.0 seconds:
She plants her right foot and immediately transfers her weight onto it. Lifting her left knee, she drives a powerful left front kick into the robot’s abdomen. The robot stumbles backward, then skids across the marked floor with a brief scrape of dust. She retracts her leg, plants both feet in a stable fighting stance, and raises her hands to guard. The camera decelerates with her. Hold the final half-second as her body settles and her twin tails continue swinging.

Audio: tightly synchronized footfalls, short air swishes, heavy metallic impacts, and scraping robot feet. No dialogue or music.

Prioritize continuous body mechanics: clear anticipation, acceleration, contact, recoil, and recovery. Speed comes from actual movement across the floor. Keep faces and torsos readable, with restrained motion blur only on fast-moving extremities and hair tips. Maintain consistent anatomy, outfit, robot structure, and subject count. No teleportation, foot sliding, limb duplication, body penetration, lingering afterimages, or flashes and smoke concealing the action. No blood, subtitles, or watermarks.
